description: Source code for a handler module managing A2A (Agent-to-Agent) completion requests via LiteLLM, including both streaming and non-streaming methods, with integration to provider configurations and transformation utilities.

classes.name: A2ACompletionBridgeHandler
classes.description: Contains static methods for handling A2A requests, including non-streaming and streaming processing, with internal logic for transforming messages and managing streaming events.

methods.name: handle_non_streaming
methods.description: Processes a non-streaming A2A request, transforming input message, invoking litellm.acompletion, and converting the response to A2A format.

methods.name: handle_streaming
methods.description: Processes a streaming A2A request, emitting initial events, handling streamed responses, accumulating content, and emitting final events.
